summary: Brief and capability research attached. Model verified working locally at fp16.
Needs a product call on how the Flow composes the caption from dropdowns, and where an LLM would run.
Caption approach settled: hybrid. Dropdowns write the deterministic blocks, the LLM writes prose only.

Both frame additions shipped: hiddenWhen (declaredFields.js + _paintFieldConstraints + the [hidden] CSS override) and format:'duration' on the slider. Promoted into docs/playbooks/add-flow/ui/carousel-frame/fields.md.

Run 3 read off the live graph (GET :48188/queue): Lyrics_Gate node 103 resolves to Empty_String on Instrumental=true and the encoder's lyrics input is empty - CHECK 1 CLOSED. CHECK 2 could not run: Reuse restored the enhancer's three caption blocks without their ownership, so _enhanceWrote was empty, a source edit cleared nothing and _autoEnhance skipped - the enhancer could never run again on a reused card. Fixed by riding ownership in the snapshot (_collectInputs emits enhanceWrote, _enhanceWrote seeds from it). 881/881 unit (3 new in tests/flow-enhance-ownership.test.cjs), 13/13 desktop flow specs, eslint clean. The instrumental confirmation run is still owed.

Bare tags into the lyrics slot. Lyrics_Gate's true arm stopped carrying Empty_String: new graph nodes Input_Structure (104) and Bare_Tags (105) send the user's section names into the encoder with every word stripped out, via one RegexReplace whitelisting MiniMax's nine tags. The rule was never 'no lyrics' - runs 1 and 2 proved WORDS get sung, brackets or not, so the guard and the bench now assert 'no word outside a tag' and Suno-style bracketed directions are DELETED rather than passed. Verified against the engine's own source (nodes_string.py: plain re.sub, case_insensitive default; prompt.py normalize_lyrics discards the whitespace between tags). 882/882 unit, 23/23 injection guard (4 new asserts), 13/13 desktop flow specs, eslint clean, sim_caption.py 4/4. minimax-music:Input_Structure removed from INJECTOR_DERIVED - it addresses a node now. One Generate with Instrumental ON is still owed for the audio.

Instrumental-run item closed on run 4 (Fabio's ears: nothing sung or hummed). New open item: bare tags built, needs one Generate with Instrumental ON to judge whether the sections now land where he put them.

L30 built, but NOT as written: the `@` picker is opt-in per field (mentions: 'Input_Voices') via a new js/utils/mentionPicker.js, NOT extracted onto MpiInput - Fabio: "only the lyrics box gets it". It inserts a VOICE (<Singer A>), not a ref tag. 9/9 new tests, 925/925, 13/13 desktop, lint clean. DRIFT: the 09-10 handoff credited MPI-694's Sound & Music run to this card - the Song run has NEVER happened, Fabio aborted it when `@` failed. The DOM half is unproven in the app.

The `@` voice picker VERIFIED IN THE APP by Fabio - "The @ symbol now works": lists man (Male) / woman (Female) off the live roster, inserts <man> on its own line. One bug in between, worth more than the fix: MpiButton's `label` is ICON-mode only, so text-mode rows mounted as real, styled, EMPTY buttons with no error (`text` is the prop). Also shipped: the step hint now teaches round brackets - normalize_lyrics splits on SQUARE brackets only, so (...) is a BACKING VOCAL, not a note to the model. OPEN: the popup covers the step title (cosmetic); the Song RUN is generating now and still needs Fabio's ears.

The `@` SECTION-TAG picker is built - the SECOND picker this box has had, and the first one that executes. Typing @ in Lyrics offers MiniMax's nine section tags and inserts the pick in SQUARE brackets on its own line. Source is a CLOSED `tags` array on the field, never a `mentions` pointer at a sibling field (that key stays deleted). spliceMentionTag gained one optional `wrap`, angle by default, so MpiPromptBox is untouched - angle is exactly what Strip_Voice_Markers eats. ALSO CORRECTED AT SOURCE: the 'THE SONG RUN, STILL OWED' item was false for a day; it ran five times on 2026-09-11/12. That is the THIRD time a checklist line on this card was read as a record of fact.

934/934 unit, 16/16 desktop flow specs, eslint + lint:components clean. The two checks that matter are written not to pass a broken feature: the nine tags are asserted against the GRAPH's own regex_pattern in comfy_workflows/flow_minimax_music.json (a tenth word offered here would pass normalize_lyrics' bracket split and be SUNG), and the new tests/desktop/flow-section-tag-picker.spec.js drives the real popup, asserting the rows have TEXT and non-zero HEIGHT - the label-vs-text bug shipped empty rows to Fabio last time and an element-exists test passed it. The previously-red peer file tests/audio-waveform-alpha.test.cjs is green now. OPEN: Fabio's own eyes in the app, and the popup still covers the step title (cosmetic, carried over from the first picker).

The @ section-tag picker is VERIFIED IN THE APP by Fabio - "Looks good, my man." Read his concurrent run flowSong_011 (Music Maker) for what it settles: it does NOT test the cast question - Input_Voices is a ONE-ROW roster, Voice 1 (Female), so it is not a sixth row in the duet-vs-solo table. It DOES confirm two things: he hand-typed the section tags ([Instrumental] bare, then [Verse], then [Chorus]), which is exactly the grammar the new picker now types for him; and the 1aab648d recipe fix is working - four words of Voice notes came back with 'Section placement: ...' carried through, the key that used to be dropped. 160s asked, 76.4s delivered (ffprobe) for 221.8s of compute: fifth confirmation that Input_Duration is a ceiling the AR ignores, not truncation. OPEN: the popup covers the step title (cosmetic, carried from the first picker); /mpi-flow-graphics for the tile and hero, which still show <Singer A>.

The picker ANCHORS AT THE CARET now - Fabio folded the cosmetic in by asking for the behaviour he expected instead of a patch: "I would much rather prefer that the picker would show up where the cursor is." No native API exists for a textarea caret's pixel position, so caretOffset() uses the standard mirror div (20 computed properties copied, because every one of them changes where a line WRAPS). Anchored on the @ itself so it does not crawl while the query is typed; flips above the line against the VIEWPORT, not the host. bottom/left in MpiBaseFlow.css are now the resting place, not the anchor, and the stylesheet says so. Proven to bite: with position() disabled the desktop spec goes RED with both anchors at y=350, the old pinned corner. 934/934 unit, 16/16 desktop, eslint + lint:components clean. MpiPromptBox keeps its own older copy and is still corner-pinned - out of scope. NEXT: /mpi-flow-graphics, GPU cleared by Fabio.
